at åbne.explanation: "At åbne" means "to open". You can open a door, a shop or a bank account. "Hvornår åbner I?" (When do you open?) is what you ask a shop or office.

sentence.da: Døren er lukket, så jeg må **åbne** den.
sentence.en: The door is closed, so I have to open it.

et år.explanation: "Et år" means "a year". It is also how you give your age: "Jeg er tredive år gammel" means "I am thirty years old". "Næste år" means "next year".

sentence.da: Der er tolv måneder i et **år**.
sentence.en: There are twelve months in a year.

åben.explanation: "Åben" means "open", for doors, shops and windows, and also for people who are open-minded. The similar-looking "at åbne" means "to open" (an action), while "åben" describes how something is: "Butikken er åben" (The shop is open).

sentence.en: The shop is open until six o'clock.

åbningstider.explanation: "Åbningstider" means "opening hours", the times when a shop or an office is open. It is usually used in the plural: "Hvad er jeres åbningstider?" (What are your opening hours?). It is made of "åbning" (opening) and "tider" (times).

sentence.da: Butikkens **åbningstider** er fra ni til seks.
sentence.en: The shop's opening hours are from nine to six.
